column2: a heavyset middle-aged office worker in a short-sleeve dress shirt and a wide patterned tie, leaning one elbow on a big old beige CRT computer monitor on a desk, giving a huge cheesy double thumbs up with an over-the-top cocky grin

a man in his forties in a loud floral Hawaiian shirt and dark sunglasses, reclining in a folding beach lounge chair, a laptop resting on his belly, one hand behind his head and the other holding a tall drink with a paper umbrella, a smug lazy smile
a woman in her thirties in a boxy 2000s blazer with big blow-dried hair, holding an old flip phone up in each raised hand like two trophies, mouth wide open in a triumphant shout

a woman in her fifties in a 1990s power suit with big shoulder pads and pearl earrings, leaning back in a big leather executive chair with both arms spread wide on the armrests, a satisfied boss smile, a wide desk with a corded desk phone and stacks of paper in front of her
